apr.notes: 0% introductory APR on purchases and on balance transfers made within 60 days of opening for the first 15 billing cycles, then 17.24% to 28.24% variable; cash advance APR 30.74%.

rewards.redemption_notes: Loyalty Points have their maximum value when deposited into an eligible Edward Jones account (15,000 points worth up to $150); other redemptions such as statement credits, travel or gift cards may be worth less. Points expire 5 years after the calendar quarter in which they were earned.
